_note: The GT911 touch controller's tuned registers. They live in the
controller's own flash: they survive power-off, a reflash and
--erase-all, and nothing else in this repo can see them. Before this
file existed the only trace of them was prose in a task list.
'expected' is the baseline task 53 tuned the panel to (86ms -> 28ms of
touch latency) and is edited BY HAND, on purpose. 'previous' is the way
back if a change makes the panel worse. 'observed' is rewritten by
goes red, the bench board is not in the tuned state -- decide which side
